_note: Candidate registry for Georgia 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Georgia Secretary of State, Elections Division, list of candidates to appear on the November 3, 2026 General Election Ballot (November 2026 Federal and State Candidates.xlsx inside the linked zip; spreadsheet last modified September 1, 2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Georgia Secretary of State, Elections Division, list of candidates to appear on the November 3, 2026 General Election Ballot (November 2026 Federal and State Candidates.xlsx inside the linked zip; spreadsheet last modified September 1, 2026) (https://sos.ga.gov/sites/default/files/2026-09/November%202026%20Federal%20and%20State%20Candidates%202026.zip); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
